# M76 hosted continuation: failed baseline diagnosis

Prepared 2026-09-16 by `/root/m76_cto`, task `M76-HOSTED-BASELINE-DIAGNOSIS`. Requested inherited CTO route Sol/high; actual compute unknown. Root owns hosted execution, Git and shared records. This work authors a read-only diagnostic addon; it changes no frozen helper, runtime, schema or journal.

## Observed failure and limits

The actual new recovery baseline failed with zero application POSTs and all created Auth sessions closed. `.superpowers/m76-hosted-recovery.jsonl` contains two valid events: attempt started at `2026-09-16T15:53:59.439Z`, failed finish at `2026-09-16T16:00:34.498Z`, stage `authoritative_failed_state`. Terminal hash is `b9db5630321e6dc5fa50ede903996c29ad17b9ab4e777f982f60bd1a10c8b6b4`; byte SHA-256 is `283e125e000019e037b19fafa89a96c297e4fd92fb08b76c1a11cc56fbed283f`.

The original failed exercise journal remains byte SHA-256 `8b1c1ddbcfefbe398bb6b79390029be34aa2782a5a4c2fa4546e783e7b0b5fb3`. Neither failed attempt is accepted or resumable by its unchanged helper. The independently reviewed local continuation previously passed against exact copies of the original failed hosted19 data using the same frozen files. That evidence used actual local API/database/Python authority execution with offline Auth/legacy adapters; it cannot establish the cause of this hosted-only failure.

The generic stage spans six concurrent register fetches and client decoders, exact failed-state version/review/blocker comparisons, all retained original versions, and all historical exports, statements, report HTML/JSON and proofs. The attempt took approximately 395 seconds. The stage and duration do not identify one initial fetch or prove a timeout. Possible differences to investigate include remote response status/body/cache behavior, request latency under concurrent API/database/Python work, and the existing 30-second per-request abort. No cause is established.

## Bounded diagnostic addon

`tools/staging/m76-hosted-baseline-diagnostic.ts` invokes the unchanged recovery helper in baseline mode through its supported dependencies, using an isolated in-memory helper journal. It refuses every other input mode before transport. Its observer refuses **all application methods except GET before calling fetch**, even if the frozen helper attempted an ordinary successor. Auth POSTs admit only the fixed project's password-token and local-session logout endpoints. Other origins, tenants, query variants and admin paths are refused.

Both failed journal byte hashes, the failed recovery terminal hash/two-event status, and exact frozen helper/recipe hashes are mandatory preconditions. The addon creates an exclusive private `.superpowers/m76-baseline-diagnostic-<timestamp>.jsonl`. It never appends to, truncates, renames or rewrites either failed journal. It checks their unchanged bytes at completion. The trace is serialized and flushed; trace failure refuses further diagnostic work, while logout transport remains allowed so its own sessions can close.

Each request records a sanitized route with UUIDs replaced, method, call index, response status, elapsed time through full body receipt, body byte count/hash and a derived no-store boolean. Auth records omit body/hash/header observations. Failures record only `aborted_or_timeout` or `transport_or_body_bound`; no error strings, tokens, passwords, request bodies, raw response text or headers are logged.

Successful register GETs additionally run the existing family decoder and record verification/duration. Grouped boolean comparisons identify the original corporate head/review/actors, equipment head/absent review/two expected blockers, two gas streams/one generator, each current stationary head/review, and retained original family versions. Historical downloads with original baseline observations additionally record exact byte-hash/length matches or canonical proof-hash matches. The unchanged helper still performs its own complete comparisons and download/client checks. A final isolated helper event records only status, generic stage, application POST count and session closure. A refusal following successful transport without a false grouped comparison remains an internal client/precondition refusal; the preceding exact call sequence narrows it but is not a fabricated diagnosis.

Root authorized a narrow `cached_diagnostic_only` legacy adapter: the real failed run already reached the authoritative stage after passing its old legacy phase. The addon supplies only the original retained legacy snapshot for that isolated dependency; it creates no legacy Auth sessions or writes. Readiness, all current family records and historical downloads remain actual GETs. The trace and summary explicitly label this cache. It is not fresh legacy or baseline acceptance evidence.

Every diagnostic summary sets `officialBaselineAccepted:false` and zero application POSTs. Even if the isolated unchanged baseline logic completes, both real failed attempts remain failed, and no exercise, journal reset or retry is authorized. Root must reconcile the read failure, obtain independent review of any necessary change and define a separately authorized continuation before any application write.

## Review and local evidence

Local private tests use only synthetic inputs and a stubbed 503 readiness response; they make no hosted calls. They challenge application mutation routes, alternate origin/tenant/auth paths, non-baseline modes before transport, trace sanitization, retained failed journal bytes and refusal to claim official acceptance. The addon bundles independently. Exact final source/test hashes and independent review are recorded in root's handoff evidence before root runs the addon with its existing private input wrapper. The original recovery helper and recipe remain frozen at `d7592d1d1f72a83e45014ce1d5d215831ff20da418ec3189f948ec3677cae59e` and `adac50e2d89b8c0b30df143426ddcccc694e1a2d339c6ec1547ee5e81b03ba15`.

## Actual diagnostic outcome

Root executed the independently reviewed read-only addon once. `.superpowers/m76-baseline-diagnostic-1789574873811.jsonl` has 261 events, byte SHA-256 `6e7f9cbcc500593ec9f8b90762245371741076cbdb8f48efd6cf5a5a30d30cad`, and finished at `2026-09-16T16:14:23.925Z` after 390,114ms. Its 89 calls comprise 81 application GETs and four actual sign-ins/logouts each. All six register decoders, 18 grouped preconditions and 54 original historical download observations passed; there were no negative observations. Both manager identities matched. The unchanged isolated baseline logic completed, zero application writes occurred, every created session closed, and both failed journals remained unchanged. Root retained its summary in `.superpowers/m76-baseline-diagnostic-root-result.json`.

The cause of the first actual baseline failure remains unreproduced. This diagnostic establishes successful current reads and comparisons; it does not establish what failed earlier. Its cached old legacy dependency and in-memory helper journal do not demonstrate a fresh full legacy baseline or the official baseline's durable journal append. Both real attempts remain failed. No runtime/schema patch follows from this observation.

## Explicit separate continuation boundary

Root authorized a separate wrapper after the successful read-only diagnosis, subject to independent review before another official read. `tools/staging/m76-hosted-continuation.ts` uses the unchanged recovery helper and recipe through only their supported journal load/append and original-evidence dependencies. Actual execution substitutes neither fetch, Auth nor legacy transport. It requires a fresh full actual baseline before its exercise; the diagnostic cannot supply that baseline.

Every mode verifies the exact original failed exercise, the second failed baseline byte/head pins, two-event failed/zero-write/closed status with no intents, and the exact successful diagnostic bytes/source/completion observations. The frozen helper/recipe hashes and unchanged 21 operation keys remain mandatory. An exclusive flushed lock prevents simultaneous invocations. Its fresh baseline exclusively creates `.superpowers/m76-hosted-continuation.jsonl` with a hash-chained `continuation_provenance` event binding both failed attempts, diagnostic, wrapper/helper/recipe bytes and exact keys. The frozen helper extends that same new chain. Neither failed journal is replaced, reset, promoted or edited; a sidecar is unnecessary.

Later exercise/revisit modes require the exact same provenance and clean, closed, verified history before invoking the unchanged helper. Any failed or unresolved attempt, changed source/provenance, altered journal or uncertain write refuses continuation. A second baseline refuses an existing file, including provenance-only or failed files. The wrapper never deletes journals or retries application requests; it releases only its own lock. A new failure requires a separate audited board/root decision. Root separately controls the fresh baseline and subsequent 21-write exercise authorization, service restart and read-only revisit.

The new self-contained CI suite `tools/staging/m76-hosted-continuation.test.ts` passed eight tests/70 assertions using in-memory files only. It challenges zero-write evidence, diagnostic pins/acceptance limits, exclusive new-journal routing, provenance changes, exact hash-chain appends, failed/uncertain/unclosed refusal and durability failure; no private fixtures are needed. Supplemental private `.superpowers/m76-baseline-diagnostic-continuation-integration.test.ts` passed one test/15 assertions: the actual unchanged helper reads original evidence but sends only a stubbed 503 readiness request, appends the new provenance/attempt/closed failure chain in memory, and refuses all subsequent modes. No hosted call or disk-journal write occurs in either test. This wrapper makes no calculation/runtime change, so no repeated 21-operation native rehearsal is claimed or required for its journal boundary.

name: Verify

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: verify-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  native-postgres:
    name: Native PostgreSQL worksheet and tenant regression
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: m63_test_admin
          POSTGRES_DB: m63_integration
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
        ports:
          - 55463:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U m63_test_admin -d m63_integration"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.12
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Initialize and challenge isolated PostgreSQL roles and storage
        run: bun test packages/neuvetra-database/src/hosted.test.ts
        env:
          M63_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m63_integration
      - name: Verify staged HTTP and frontend decoding against PostgreSQL
        run: bun test apps/site-api/src/staging/postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m66-postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m67-postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m68-postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m71-postgres.test.ts
        env:
          M63_API_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m63_integration
          M71_API_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m63_integration
      - name: Prepare isolated stationary natural-gas native fixture
        run: bun tools/staging/m73-backend-fixture.ts m73_author_ci --ci-baseline=m63_integration
      - name: Verify stationary natural-gas storage, calculation, reports and browser decoder
        run: bun test apps/site-api/src/workspace/m73-postgres.test.ts
        env:
          M73_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m73_author_ci
      - name: Prepare isolated mobile-diesel native fixture
        run: bun tools/staging/m74-backend-fixture.ts m74_author_ci --ci-baseline=m63_integration
      - name: Verify mobile-diesel storage, two-evidence calculation, reports and browser decoder
        run: bun test apps/site-api/src/workspace/m74-postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/calculation/m74-authority.test.ts
        env:
          M74_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m74_author_ci
      - name: Independently verify mobile-diesel accounting against frozen source oracle
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m74-independent-accounting-native.test.ts
        env:
          M74_ACCOUNTING_TEMPLATE_DATABASE: m74_author_ci

      - name: Prepare isolated controlled-fleet native fixture
        run: bun tools/staging/m75-backend-fixture.ts m75_author_ci --ci-baseline=m63_integration
      - name: Verify controlled-fleet persistence, reconciliation and access boundaries
        run: bun test apps/site-api/src/workspace/m75-postgres.test.ts
        env:
          M75_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m75_author_ci
      - name: Prepare isolated stationary equipment native fixture
        run: bun tools/staging/m76-backend-fixture.ts m76_author_ci --ci-baseline=m63_integration
      - name: Verify stationary equipment persistence, exact calculation and access boundaries
        run: bun test apps/site-api/src/workspace/m76-postgres.test.ts
        env:
          M76_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m76_author_ci
      - name: Independently challenge stationary arithmetic and historical proof
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-native.test.ts
        env:
          M76_INDEPENDENT_NATIVE: enabled
          M76_QA_TEMPLATE: m76_author_ci
      - name: Independently challenge cross-family fuel evidence and retained capacity
        run: |
          bun test evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-native-security.test.ts
          bun test evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-native-capacity.test.ts
          bun test evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-native-report-capacity.test.ts
        env:
          M76_INDEPENDENT_NATIVE: enabled

      - name: Independently challenge controlled-fleet native lifecycle and direct SQL admission
        run: |
          bun test evaluations/research-qa/m75-independent-native.test.ts
          bun run evaluations/research-qa/m75-independent-direct-sql.ts
          bun run evaluations/research-qa/m75-independent-sql-parity.ts
        env:
          M75_INDEPENDENT_NATIVE: enabled
          M75_QA_TEMPLATE: m63_integration

      - name: Exercise controlled-fleet publication journey against isolated local routes
        run: bun test tools/staging/check-m75-hosted.test.ts
        env:
          M75_HOSTED_NATIVE_SOURCE: m75_author_ci

  applications:
    name: Typecheck, lint, unit tests and web builds
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.12
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run check
      - name: Independent source-linked worksheet decoder and report cases
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m66-independent-frontend.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m66-independent-renderer.test.ts
      - name: Independent annual worksheet decoder, renderer and print-action cases
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m67-independent-frontend.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m67-independent-renderer.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m67-independent-print-view.test.ts
      - name: Independent annual evidence decoder, UI, print-action and packaging cases
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m68-independent-frontend.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m68-independent-print-view.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m68-independent-ui.test.ts
      - name: Independent corporate coverage validation, decoder and actor-lifetime cases
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m71-qa-validation.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m71-qa-frontend.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m71-qa-ui.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m71-security-frontend.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m71-security-parser.test.ts
      - name: Stationary natural-gas operator admission and preservation controls
        run: bun test tools/staging/m73-operators.test.ts
      - name: Independent mobile-diesel frontend and hosted journey controls
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m74-frontend-ui.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m74-frontend-decoder.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m74-frontend-version.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m74-frontend-registration.test.ts tools/staging/check-m74-hosted.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m74-hosted-helper-independent.test.ts tools/staging/m74-operators.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m74-security-operator-gate.test.ts
      - name: Independent controlled-fleet reconciliation, reports and browser decoding
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m75-independent-classification.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m75-independent-renderer.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m75-independent-decoder.test.ts tools/staging/m75-operators.test.ts tools/staging/check-m75-hosted.test.ts
      - name: Independent stationary equipment, generator arithmetic and historical reports
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-admission.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-authority.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-generator-decoder.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-reconciliation.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-renderer-decoder.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-report-duplicates.test.ts tools/staging/m76-operators.test.ts tools/staging/check-m76-hosted.test.ts
      - name: Additive stationary journey safety guards
        # The exact failed-state rehearsal is local and uses a private encrypted backup.
        # This guard suite runs without that journal, credentials or hosted access.
        run: bun test tools/staging/m76-hosted-recovery.test.ts
      - name: Explicit continuation journal guards
        run: bun test tools/staging/m76-hosted-continuation.test.ts
      - name: Offline cloud database boundary tests
        run: bun test tools/cloud/database-inventory.test.ts tools/cloud/apply-development.test.ts tools/cloud/data-api-exposure.test.ts tools/cloud/activate-synthetic.test.ts tools/cloud/website-publication.test.ts tools/cloud/check-website-reader.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-cloud.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-composed.test.ts tools/research/cloud-read-diagnostics.test.ts tools/research/cloud-fetch-injection.test.ts
      - name: Typecheck cloud database helper
        run: bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --types bun --strict --skipLibCheck tools/cloud/database-inventory.ts tools/cloud/database-inventory.test.ts tools/cloud/apply-development.ts tools/cloud/apply-development.test.ts tools/cloud/data-api-exposure.ts tools/cloud/data-api-exposure.test.ts tools/cloud/activate-synthetic.ts tools/cloud/activate-synthetic.test.ts tools/cloud/website-publication.ts tools/cloud/website-publication.test.ts tools/cloud/check-website-reader.ts tools/cloud/check-website-reader.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-cloud.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-cloud.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-composed.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-composed.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-questions.ts tools/research/cloud-read-diagnostics.ts tools/research/cloud-read-diagnostics.test.ts tools/research/cloud-fetch-injection.test.ts

  staging-image:
    name: Dedicated staging image and offline runtime smoke
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build explicit combined image without provider credentials
        run: docker build --platform linux/amd64 --file Dockerfile.staging --tag neuvetra-m63:${{ github.sha }} .
      - name: Verify runtime imports, pinned assets, Python and actual HTTP listener offline
        run: |
          docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint bun neuvetra-m63:${{ github.sha }} -e '
            import {createStagingServer} from "/app/apps/site-api/src/staging/server.ts";
            import {readStagingConfig,STAGING_PROFILE} from "/app/apps/site-api/src/staging/config.ts";
            import {runEngine} from "/app/apps/site-api/src/calculation/server.ts";
            const {readMigrationManifest}=await import("/app/packages/neuvetra-database/src/staging-migrations.ts");
            const manifest=await readMigrationManifest();if(manifest.length!==19||manifest[15].name!=="0016_stationary_natural_gas.sql"||manifest[16].name!=="0017_mobile_diesel.sql"||manifest[17].name!=="0018_controlled_fleet.sql"||manifest[18].name!=="0019_stationary_sources.sql")throw new Error("Incomplete image migration manifest");
            const ref="abcdefghijklmnopqrst";
            const config=readStagingConfig({NODE_ENV:"test",NEUVETRA_STAGING_ENABLED:"enabled",NEUVETRA_STAGING_PROFILE:STAGING_PROFILE,NEUVETRA_STAGING_PROJECT_REF:ref,NEUVETRA_STAGING_ORIGIN:"http://127.0.0.1:8080",SUPABASE_URL:`https://${ref}.supabase.co`,SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:"sb_publishable_synthetic_fixture_not_a_real_key",DATABASE_URL:`postgres://neuvetra_runtime:fixture@db.${ref}.supabase.co:5432/postgres`});
            const database={checkReadiness:async()=>({profile:STAGING_PROFILE,schemaVersion:19}),close:async()=>{}};
            const app=await createStagingServer(config,{database,validateUser:async()=>null,log:()=>{}});
            const server=Bun.serve({hostname:"127.0.0.1",port:8080,fetch:app.fetch});
            try {
              for(const route of ["/health","/ready","/","/workspace-api/config"]) {const r=await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:8080${route}`);if(r.status!==200||r.headers.get("cache-control")!=="no-store")throw new Error("Image HTTP smoke failed");await r.arrayBuffer();}
              const index=await (await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8080/")).text();
              const scripts=[...index.matchAll(/src="([^"]+\.js)"/g)].map(m=>m[1]);
              if(scripts.length===0)throw new Error("No built staging application");
              for(const src of scripts){if(!src.startsWith("/assets/"))throw new Error("External application script");const r=await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:8080${src}`);if(r.status!==200)throw new Error("Missing staged bundle");await r.arrayBuffer();}
              for(const route of ["/.env","/apps/site-api/src/staging/server.ts","/tools/research/m43-heldout-first-batch-v1.json"])if((await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:8080${route}`)).status!==404)throw new Error("Non-public path exposed");
              if((await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8080/workspace-api/session")).status!==401)throw new Error("Authentication boundary failed");
              const uuid="11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
              const binding={company_id:uuid,evidence_id:uuid,bill_version_id:uuid,activity_version_id:uuid,facility_id:uuid,boundary_id:uuid,bill_version:2,activity_version:1,extraction_id:uuid,parser_version:"m55-fixed-pdf-v1",previous_bill_version_id:uuid,evidence_sha256:"0a97cd0976c03af0776214fc19bdc3d4f0c00e9c835f3e116574a6f375c8e135",source_quantity_kwh:"12346.000",normalized_quantity_mwh:"12.346000",correction_reason:"Synthetic review exercise",service_period:{start:"2023-01-01",end:"2023-01-31"},facility:{name:"Synthetic California office",country:"United States",state:"California",egrid_subregion:"CAMX"},boundary:{reporting_year:2023,approach:"operational_control",status:"draft",version:1}};
              const calculation=await runEngine({action:"calculate_linked_bill",binding});
              if(calculation.status!=="ok"||calculation.record?.total?.unrounded!=="2407.9674055248")throw new Error("Container Decimal calculation failed");
              const {createM73Authority}=await import("/app/apps/site-api/src/calculation/m73-authority.ts");
              const gas=await createM73Authority().calculate({binding:{coverageVersionId:uuid,coverageVersionSha256:"a".repeat(64),entityId:uuid,facilityId:uuid,sourceId:uuid,boundaryDecisionId:uuid},period:{start:"2025-01-01",endExclusive:"2026-01-01"},fuel:"Natural Gas",heatBasis:"HHV",unit:"MMBtu",quantityMmbtu:"0.100",statementSha256:"b".repeat(64)});
              if(gas.total.unrounded!=="5.31145"||gas.total.display!=="5.3114"||gas.method.releaseEligible!==false)throw new Error("Container stationary gas Decimal calculation failed");
              const {createM74Authority}=await import("/app/apps/site-api/src/calculation/m74-authority.ts");
              const mobile=await createM74Authority().calculate({binding:{coverageVersionId:uuid,coverageVersionSha256:"a".repeat(64),entityId:uuid,facilityId:uuid,sourceId:uuid,boundaryDecisionId:uuid},period:{start:"2025-01-01",endExclusive:"2026-01-01"},vehicle:{assetId:"SYN-TRUCK-001",vehicleClass:"Medium- and Heavy-Duty Vehicles",classificationBasis:"Synthetic owned heavy-duty on-road truck controlled throughout 2025.",modelYear:2018,fuel:"Fossil Diesel",controlBasis:"owned_operational_control_full_year"},quantityGallons:"1000.125",quantityUnit:"US_gallon",distanceMiles:"12000.500",distanceUnit:"vehicle_mile",fuelStatementSha256:"b".repeat(64),mileageStatementSha256:"c".repeat(64)});
              if(mobile.total.unrounded!=="10351.53209375"||mobile.total.display!=="10351.5321"||mobile.method.releaseEligible!==false)throw new Error("Container mobile diesel Decimal calculation failed");
              const {createM76DieselAuthority}=await import("/app/apps/site-api/src/calculation/m76-authority.ts");
              const generator=await createM76DieselAuthority().calculate({binding:{coverageVersionId:uuid,coverageVersionSha256:"a".repeat(64),entityId:uuid,facilityId:uuid,sourceId:uuid,boundaryDecisionId:uuid},period:{start:"2025-01-01",endExclusive:"2026-01-01"},equipment:{assetId:"SYN-GEN-001",identifierBasis:"Fictional generator serial",equipmentType:"stationary_emergency_generator",engineType:"compression_ignition",stationaryInstallation:"fixed",controlBasis:"owned_operational_control_full_year",controlExplanation:"Fictional full year ownership and operational control",fuel:"Fossil Distillate Fuel Oil No. 2",fossilFraction:"1.000",fuelGradeBasis:"Fictional fuel grade and composition evidence"},unit:"US_gallon",quantityGallons:"25.000",statementSha256:"b".repeat(64)});
              if(generator.total.unrounded!=="256.00035"||generator.total.display!=="256.0004"||generator.method.releaseEligible!==false)throw new Error("Container generator Decimal calculation failed");
              console.info(JSON.stringify({imageSmoke:"passed",database:"injected_offline",authentication:"refusal_only",calculation:"real_python",assets:"hash_verified"}));
            } finally {await server.stop(true);await app.close();}
          '
      - name: Refuse ordinary container startup without explicit staging configuration
        run: |
          if docker run --rm --network none neuvetra-m63:${{ github.sha }}; then
            echo "Container unexpectedly started without staging configuration"
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Record exact local image identity
        run: docker image inspect neuvetra-m63:${{ github.sha }} --format '{{.Id}}'

    steps:

        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

        run: python -B -m unittest discover -s tools/cloud -p "test_*.py" -v

  ghg-calculations:
    name: GHG calculation specifications and engine
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
